en.theoretical_bound_definition: A mathematical lower or upper constraint, valid only under its stated premises. It does not give a unique material property or guarantee attainability for a specified specimen.
en.model_prediction_definition: A value or distribution estimated by a specified model for specified inputs; it is not automatically a rigorous bound.
en.experimental_record_definition: A record of a measurement, including the specimen, method, conditions, and reported uncertainty when available; it is not a universal material limit.
en.engineering_limit_definition: A design, operating, manufacturing, or acceptance constraint for a particular use; it is not automatically a theorem about material behavior.
en.uncertainty_definition: Limited knowledge or variability in values, measurements, or a model. This MVP does not quantify or propagate uncertainty.
en.applicability_unknown_definition: Evidence needed to evaluate one or more premises is missing. This status is not a probability, error bar, or numerical uncertainty interval.
en.satisfied_definition: Every required premise is supported by the supplied inputs and assertions within the implemented checks.
en.violated_definition: At least one required premise conflicts with the supplied inputs or assertions; the affected bound must not be used.
en.well_ordered_definition: The phases can be labeled so that K1 <= K2 and G1 <= G2 simultaneously.
en.scope_notice: This implementation evaluates bulk/shear HS, Reuss and Voigt bounds for two positive isotropic linear-elastic phases under the stated 3D, small-strain, static and perfectly bonded conditions. HS and the derived E/nu outer envelopes also require well-ordered phases. Strength, failure and plasticity are outside scope.

en.catalog_directional_conditions: Conditions: finite real 3D classical local linear elasticity, infinitesimal strain and a stress-free state; minor/major symmetries, full stiffness SPD on all nonzero symmetric strains, and full inverse compliance S=C^-1. Apply static uniaxial stress along unit n; measure along perpendicular unit m. Tension and extension are positive; uniaxial stress may induce shear strain.
en.catalog_directional_limits: Limits: pair constraints are necessary, not sufficient for full tensor stability. No numerical evaluator, tensor-input API, inversion service, extremum search, specimen prediction or proof of physical realizability. Excludes 2D reductions, prestress, finite strain, complex response and singular/indefinite tensors. Homogeneous elastic energy positivity is not complete phonon, strength or thermodynamic stability. Project derivations and translations lack independent scientific/native-speaker review.
en.catalog_directional_range: Material-class range: every finite real number; unbounded below and above as the full-SPD tensor and orthonormal pair vary. Infinity is not attained, and this is not an unknown range or the isotropic interval -1<nu<1/2.
en.catalog_directional_fixed_tensor: Fixed-tensor extrema: each fixed finite full-SPD compliance has finite attained minimum and maximum over orthonormal direction pairs, by continuity, compactness and a strictly positive denominator.
en.catalog_directional_pair: Same-tensor pair: nu(n,m)/E(n)=nu(m,n)/E(m); abs(nu(n,m))<sqrt(E(n)/E(m)); 0<=nu(n,m)*nu(m,n)<1. The upper inequalities are strict; zero product occurs exactly when both ratios vanish. Exchanged ratios share a sign otherwise, but need not be equal. No finite universal numerical bound follows as E(n)/E(m) varies.

en.catalog_compressibility_notice: Catalog only: mathematical hydrostatic-response relations; no tensor-input evaluator, inversion, eigenvalue solver or material prediction.
en.catalog_compressibility_conditions: Scope: finite real full-SPD stress-free 3D classical isothermal infinitesimal elasticity. Pressure p>0 is compressive: sigma=-p I, epsilon=-p(S:I). Stress is tension-positive; strain is extension-positive. Hydrostatic stress can induce shear strain; it is not imposed isotropic strain. In engineering Voigt order 11,22,33,23,13,12, e=(epsilon11,epsilon22,epsilon33,2epsilon23,2epsilon13,2epsilon12); with g=S_eng*(1,1,1,0,0,0), (B23,B13,B12)=(g4,g5,g6)/2.
en.catalog_compressibility_limits: Negative beta means directional extension under hydrostatic compression, while kappa>0 excludes negative volume compressibility. At most two principal values may be nonpositive; this does not mean at most two negative directions. This is distinct from uniaxial Poisson ratio and thermal expansion. Exclude prestress, plane reductions, singular tensors, phase changes, constrained negative-bulk systems and mass exchange. Original project proofs and machine-assisted translations are not independent scientific or native-speaker review; physical realizability is not certified.
en.catalog_compressibility_fixed_tensor: One fixed finite tensor: beta(n)=n^T B n, B=S:I; the closed range from lambda_min(B) to lambda_max(B) is finite and attained. Every orthonormal triad sums to kappa=tr B>0, so beta_min<=kappa/3<=beta_max.
en.catalog_compressibility_range: Across unrestricted finite full-SPD tensors, r=beta/kappa attains every finite real value, even at fixed positive kappa, by an original project orthotropic SPD construction. Neither infinity is attained; this is not an unbounded response of one fixed tensor.
en.catalog_compressibility_energy: For the same full compliance S, beta(n)^2<kappa/E(n), or r(n)^2<1/(kappa*E(n)). The inequality is strict and necessary, not sufficient for full SPD; equality is excluded. E(n)=1/(nn:S:nn)>0 is the uniaxial-stress Young modulus.
en.catalog_compressibility_symmetry: Cubic and isotropic full-SPD elasticity instead have r(n)=1/3 for every direction. Class-wide unboundedness does not apply to every symmetry subclass. Isotropic hydrostatic response alone does not prove full elastic isotropy.

en.catalog_wave_notice: Catalog-only bulk-wave relations: display equations and original project proofs; no numerical wave or tensor evaluator.
en.catalog_wave_conditions: Conditions: finite homogeneous stress-free 3D classical local linear elasticity, purely mechanical and nondissipative, with constant scalar mass density rho>0. The isotropic ratio additionally requires finite K>0 and G>0.
en.catalog_wave_normalization: Normalization: Q_ik=C_ijkl*n_j*n_l has units Pa; Gamma=Q/rho and its eigenvalues c^2 have units m^2 s^-2. Density has units kg m^-3 and phase speed m s^-1.
en.catalog_wave_polarization: Direction: n is the wavevector phase normal and a is displacement polarization. General anisotropic modes need not be exactly longitudinal/transverse or follow a fastest-longitudinal ordering; phase speed is not ray/group/energy velocity.
en.catalog_wave_energy: Strictness: Q(n) must be positive definite for every unit n, with zero eigenvalues excluded. Full positive symmetric-strain energy implies strong ellipticity, but the converse fails; negative K allowed by strong ellipticity is not bulk-energy stability. K=-G/3, G>0 gives Q=G I and negative hydrostatic energy.
en.catalog_wave_range: Range: for finite positive K,G,rho, cL/cT is strictly in (sqrt(4/3), infinity) across the material class; neither endpoint is attained. Each fixed isotropic material has finite direction-independent speeds and a twofold transverse mode. The range proof is an original project derivation.
en.catalog_wave_limits: Scope: use the operative tensor of this ideal mechanical model only. Static/isothermal-to-adiabatic and frequency conversions are unassessed. Exclude prestress, tangent/finite-strain, dissipative, poroelastic and nonlocal media, surface/guided/2D waves and finite-body resonances. Source equations plus project algebra are not independent scientific peer review.

en.catalog_hbn_model_notice: These two hBN summaries share one study and are model-dependent, catalog-only observations. They are not independent confirmations, universal bounds or engineering allowables; no evaluation, ranking or matched-condition comparison is implied.
en.catalog_hbn_thickness_notice: The 0.334 nm effective thickness is a source-assigned model/conversion convention, distinct from the illustrated 0.48 nm AFM apparent height. Both selected N/m values are explicitly printed by the source; no curator thickness conversion generates them.
en.catalog_hbn_specimen_notice: The authors describe high-quality single crystals; no quantitative defect census or specimen-wide defect-free proof is available. Preparation, reported oxidative stability and computational temperature are not measured indentation test conditions.
en.catalog_hbn_sd_notice: SD provenance: the public peer-review author response, PDF p. 8, Reviewer #1 question 3, defines the deviations as standard deviations and refers to Figures 3–4. The main-text ± notation alone does not define SD. These are not SEMs, confidence intervals, hard bounds or a full uncertainty budget; replicate weighting and coverage are unknown.
en.catalog_hbn_tip_notice: The 5.6 and 6.3 nm tip radii are two source-reported TEM measurements, not a mean ± tolerance. Figure S4 shows a 12.6 nm diameter example; assignment of either tip to each sheet and radius uncertainties are unknown.
en.catalog_hbn_poisson_notice: ν = 0.211 is adopted from prior work for the source stiffness model, not measured on these specimens.
en.catalog_hbn_stress_strain_notice: The finite-strain stress and strain measures in Eq. 4 are unspecified. Figure 5 separately labels strain nominal. Neither that label nor the S5 maximum Von Mises diagnostic establishes the stress component of the volume average or a Cauchy/Piola convention; no Lee or MoS2 convention is inherited.
en.catalog_hbn_strength_notice: Strength inference: nonlinear elastic ABAQUS analysis of an axisymmetric membrane, rigid spherical indenter and frictionless contact. At the experimental fracture load, stresses of elements beneath the tip are volume-averaged within a nonuniform stress field. This is not uniform tensile strength, a local maximum-stress formula or the S5 maximum-stress output.
en.catalog_hbn_fem_input_notice: E and D are source FEM inputs, not additional selected property records. The equivalent elastic-plastic implementation does not demonstrate physical plasticity. Simulation endpoint and step size are numerical settings, not a measured mean fracture displacement or experimental loading rate.
en.catalog_hbn_diagnostic_notice: Supplement Figure S5 (PDF p. 5) plots maximum Von Mises stress, distinct from the volume-averaged under-indenter strength. Its reported 25.7% linear-model overestimate is a model-sensitivity illustration, not a correction, uncertainty or multiplier for 23.6 ± 1.8 N/m.
en.catalog_hbn_stiffness_notice: Stiffness inference fits the source circular-membrane force–deflection law to loading curves for E2D and pretension. The isotropic tension/stretching model has no bending term; its central-load approximation is not the finite-radius nonlinear FEM failure model.
en.catalog_hbn_q_notice: The source prints the q formula with 1.049 and ν = 0.211, but no separate numerical q. The value 0.9898768854482001 is curator arithmetic only; the actual implemented fit constant remains unknown. No printed-q discrepancy was identified, no constant was replaced and no refit was performed.
en.catalog_hbn_curve_selection_notice: The authors retain loading/unloading curves without obvious hysteresis and exclude large-hysteresis curves. Exact exclusion thresholds and acquired, retained and excluded totals are unknown; no raw curves or fit/FEM code were reanalysed.
en.catalog_hbn_conditions_notice: Ambient is qualitative: numerical temperature, humidity, pressure and atmospheric gas composition are unknown. Do not assign standard ambient values or infer matched environments.
en.catalog_hbn_velocity_notice: The reported 0.5 μm/s is loading/unloading translation velocity, not membrane strain rate or stress rate. The 0.1 nm FEM increment is a numerical step, not experimental velocity.
en.catalog_hbn_count_notice: N means tested sheets, as clarified in the peer-review author response (PDF p. 8). N = 11 is attached to the stiffness average, not an independently verified strength-replicate or failure count. Typically five increasing-load indentations per sheet is not an exact protocol total; multiplying these numbers cannot establish 55 acquired or retained curves.
en.catalog_hbn_inspection_notice: Publisher HTML and displayed equations 1, 2 and 4 were inspected; supplement PDF pages 4–5 and peer-review PDF page 8 were visually checked. The main article PDF was not inspected. A separate reader checked transcription of the same artifacts; this is not independent scientific review, raw-data reanalysis, plot digitization or replication.

zh.catalog_directional_limits: 限制：成对约束是必要条件，不足以判定整个张量的稳定性。不提供数值求解器、张量输入接口、求逆服务、极值搜索、试样预测或物理可实现性证明。不包括二维约化、预应力、有限应变、复数响应及奇异或不定张量。均匀弹性能严格正定不等于完整的声子、强度或热力学稳定性。项目推导和翻译尚未经独立科学审查或母语审校。
zh.catalog_directional_range: 材料张量类范围：可得到任意有限实数；随完整正定张量和正交单位方向对变化，向下和向上均无界。无穷不是可取值；这不是未知范围，也不是各向同性区间 -1<nu<1/2。
zh.catalog_directional_fixed_tensor: 固定张量的极值：对每个固定、有限、完整正定的柔度张量，方向泊松比在正交单位方向对上均有有限且可取到的最小值和最大值；依据为连续性、紧致性及严格为正的分母。
zh.catalog_directional_pair: 同一张量的成对关系：nu(n,m)/E(n)=nu(m,n)/E(m)；abs(nu(n,m))<sqrt(E(n)/E(m))；0<=nu(n,m)*nu(m,n)<1。上端不等式严格；乘积为零当且仅当两个比值均为零。否则互换方向的比值同号，但不必相等。E(n)/E(m) 变化时，不能由此得到有限的通用数值界限。

zh.catalog_name_normalized_directional_comp: 归一化方向线压缩率：张量类取值范围与能量约束
zh.catalog_compressibility_notice: 仅目录：静水应力响应的数学关系；不提供张量输入求值、求逆、特征值求解或材料预测。
zh.catalog_compressibility_conditions: 适用范围：有限实数、完整严格正定、无初始应力的三维经典等温无穷小弹性。压力 p>0 表示压缩：sigma=-p I，epsilon=-p(S:I)；应力以拉伸为正，应变以伸长为正。静水应力可引起剪切应变，不等于施加各向同性应变。工程 Voigt 顺序为 11,22,33,23,13,12，e=(epsilon11,epsilon22,epsilon33,2epsilon23,2epsilon13,2epsilon12)；若 g=S_eng*(1,1,1,0,0,0)，则 (B23,B13,B12)=(g4,g5,g6)/2。
zh.catalog_compressibility_limits: beta<0 表示静水压缩下沿某方向伸长；kappa>0 排除负体积压缩率。至多两个主值可非正，并不表示至多两个方向具有负值。此量不同于单轴泊松比或热膨胀。排除预应力、平面降维、奇异张量、相变、受约束负体积响应及质量交换。项目原创证明和机器辅助翻译不构成独立科学同行评审或母语审校，也不证明物理可实现性。
zh.catalog_compressibility_fixed_tensor: 对一个固定的有限张量，beta(n)=n^T B n，B=S:I；从 lambda_min(B) 到 lambda_max(B) 的闭区间范围有限且端点可达。任意正交归一三方向的压缩率之和均为 kappa=tr B>0，因此 beta_min<=kappa/3<=beta_max。
zh.catalog_compressibility_range: 遍历不附加对称性限制的有限完整严格正定张量时，r=beta/kappa 可取任意有限实数，即使固定正 kappa 也成立；证明采用项目原创的正交各向异性严格正定构造。正负无穷均不可达，也不表示一个固定张量具有无穷响应。
zh.catalog_compressibility_energy: 对同一个完整柔度 S，有 beta(n)^2<kappa/E(n)，即 r(n)^2<1/(kappa*E(n))。这是严格正定的严格必要条件，而非充分条件；等号不可达。E(n)=1/(nn:S:nn)>0 是单轴应力杨氏模量。
zh.catalog_compressibility_symmetry: 立方和各向同性完整严格正定弹性在所有方向均有 r(n)=1/3。整个张量类无界不代表每个对称性子类都无界；静水响应各向同性也不能证明完整弹性各向同性。

ja.catalog_directional_conditions: 条件：有限の実数成分を持つ三次元の古典的・局所的な線形弾性、微小ひずみ、無応力の基準状態。小対称性と主対称性を持ち、完全な剛性テンソルはすべての非零の対称ひずみに対して正定値であり、完全な逆テンソルがコンプライアンス S=C^-1 である。単位ベクトル n 方向に静的単軸応力を加え、それに直交する単位ベクトル m 方向で測定する。引張応力と伸びを正とし、単軸応力でもせん断ひずみが生じ得る。
ja.catalog_directional_limits: 制限：方向の対に関する制約は必要条件であり、テンソル全体の安定性の十分条件ではない。数値計算機能、テンソル入力 API、逆行列計算、極値探索、試験片の予測、物理的実現可能性の証明は提供しない。二次元への縮約、予応力、有限ひずみ、複素数応答、特異・不定テンソルを除外する。一様な弾性エネルギーの正定値性は、完全なフォノン・強度・熱力学的安定性を意味しない。プロジェクトの導出と翻訳は独立した科学的査読・母語話者の校閲を受けていない。
ja.catalog_directional_range: 材料テンソル集合での範囲：任意の有限実数。完全な正定値テンソルと直交単位方向対を変えると、上下とも非有界となる。無限大は達成値ではなく、範囲が不明という意味でも、等方性の区間 -1<nu<1/2 でもない。
ja.catalog_directional_fixed_tensor: 固定テンソルの極値：固定した有限の完全な正定値コンプライアンスでは、直交単位方向対に関する最小値・最大値は有限で達成される。連続性、コンパクト性、厳密に正の分母による。
ja.catalog_directional_pair: 同じテンソルの対の関係：nu(n,m)/E(n)=nu(m,n)/E(m)、abs(nu(n,m))<sqrt(E(n)/E(m))、0<=nu(n,m)*nu(m,n)<1。上限側の不等式は厳密であり、積がゼロになるのは両方の比がゼロの場合に限る。それ以外は方向を交換した比が同符号となるが、等しいとは限らない。E(n)/E(m) が変化するため、有限の普遍的な数値限界は導かれない。

ja.catalog_compressibility_conditions: 範囲：有限の実数成分を持つ、全体が厳密に正定値の、無応力基準状態における三次元古典等温微小ひずみ弾性。p>0 は圧縮圧力で、sigma=-p I、epsilon=-p(S:I)。応力は引張り、ひずみは伸びを正とします。静水圧応力でもせん断ひずみは生じ得るため、等方ひずみの強制とは異なります。工学 Voigt 順序は 11,22,33,23,13,12、e=(epsilon11,epsilon22,epsilon33,2epsilon23,2epsilon13,2epsilon12)。g=S_eng*(1,1,1,0,0,0) に対し (B23,B13,B12)=(g4,g5,g6)/2 です。
ja.catalog_compressibility_limits: 負の beta は静水圧圧縮下での方向伸長を意味し、kappa>0 は負の体積圧縮率を除外します。非正の主値は高々二つですが、負となる方向が高々二つという意味ではありません。一軸ポアソン比や熱膨張とは別の量です。初期応力、平面縮約、特異テンソル、相転移、拘束された負の体積応答、質量交換を除外します。プロジェクト独自の証明と機械支援翻訳は独立した科学査読や母語話者の校閲ではなく、物理的実現可能性も保証しません。
ja.catalog_compressibility_fixed_tensor: 固定した一つの有限テンソルでは beta(n)=n^T B n、B=S:I。lambda_min(B) から lambda_max(B) までの閉区間が値域で、有限な両端点は達成されます。任意の正規直交三方向の和は kappa=tr B>0 なので beta_min<=kappa/3<=beta_max です。
ja.catalog_compressibility_range: 対称性を追加制限しない有限・全体正定値テンソル集合では、r=beta/kappa は任意の有限実数を取ります。正の kappa を固定しても、独自の直交異方性正定値構成で証明できます。正負の無限大は達成されず、固定した一つのテンソルが無限応答を持つという意味でもありません。
ja.catalog_compressibility_energy: 同一の完全なコンプライアンス S に対し beta(n)^2<kappa/E(n)、すなわち r(n)^2<1/(kappa*E(n))。これは全体正定値性の厳密な必要条件であり十分条件ではなく、等号は成立しません。E(n)=1/(nn:S:nn)>0 は一軸応力によるヤング率です。
ja.catalog_compressibility_symmetry: 立方晶および等方性の全体正定値弾性では、すべての方向で r(n)=1/3 です。集合全体の非有界性をすべての対称性部分集合に適用してはいけません。静水圧応答の等方性だけでは完全な弾性等方性を証明できません。

ja.catalog_wave_conditions: 条件：有限で均質、初期応力のない三次元の古典的局所線形弾性体。純粋に力学的で非散逸、一定のスカラー質量密度 rho>0 を仮定します。等方性速度比には有限の K>0 と G>0 も必要です。

ja.catalog_wave_polarization: 方向：n は波数ベクトルの位相法線、a は変位の偏極です。一般の異方性モードは厳密な縦波・横波とは限らず、縦波が最速とも限りません。位相速度は波線・群・エネルギー速度ではありません。
ja.catalog_wave_energy: 厳密性：すべての単位方向 n で Q(n) が正定値であり、ゼロ固有値は除外されます。非ゼロ対称ひずみに対するエネルギーの正定値性は強楕円性を含意しますが、逆は成立しません。強楕円性で許される負の K は体積ひずみエネルギーの安定性を意味しません。K=-G/3、G>0 では Q=G I ですが静水圧ひずみのエネルギーは負です。
ja.catalog_wave_range: 範囲：有限の正の K,G,rho の材料クラス全体で cL/cT は開区間 (sqrt(4/3), infinity) に属し、両端点は達成されません。固定した等方性材料の速度は有限かつ方向非依存で、横波は二重縮退します。範囲の証明はプロジェクト独自の導出です。
ja.catalog_wave_limits: 適用範囲：この理想力学モデルで実際に作用する構成テンソルのみを用います。静的・等温弾性率から断熱弾性率への変換や周波数依存の変換は未評価です。初期応力、接線・有限ひずみ、散逸、間隙弾性、非局所媒質、表面波・導波・二次元波、有限物体の共振を除外します。原典の方程式とプロジェクトの代数検証は独立した科学的査読ではありません。

de.catalog_directional_conditions: Bedingungen: endliche reelle klassische lokale 3D-Linear-Elastizität, infinitesimale Dehnungen und spannungsfreier Referenzzustand; kleine und große Tensorsymmetrien, vollständige Steifigkeit positiv definit auf allen von null verschiedenen symmetrischen Dehnungen, vollständige inverse Nachgiebigkeit S=C^-1. Statischer einachsiger Spannungszustand in Einheitsrichtung n; Messung in der orthogonalen Einheitsrichtung m. Zugspannung und Verlängerung sind positiv; einachsige Spannung kann Scherdehnungen erzeugen.
de.catalog_directional_limits: Grenzen: Paarbedingungen sind notwendig, aber nicht hinreichend für die Stabilität des gesamten Tensors. Kein numerischer Löser, keine Tensor-Eingabe-API, Inversion, Extremwertsuche, Probenvorhersage oder Bestätigung physikalischer Realisierbarkeit. Ausgeschlossen sind 2D-Reduktionen, Vorspannung, endliche Dehnungen, komplexe Antwort sowie singuläre oder indefinite Tensoren. Positive homogene elastische Energie belegt keine vollständige Phononen-, Festigkeits- oder thermodynamische Stabilität. Projektherleitungen und Übersetzungen wurden nicht unabhängig wissenschaftlich oder muttersprachlich geprüft.
de.catalog_directional_range: Wertebereich der Materialtensorklasse: alle endlichen reellen Zahlen; nach unten und oben unbeschränkt, wenn vollständiger SPD-Tensor und orthonormales Richtungspaar variieren. Unendlich ist kein angenommener Wert; der Bereich ist weder unbekannt noch das isotrope Intervall -1<nu<1/2.
de.catalog_directional_fixed_tensor: Extrema eines festen Tensors: Für jede feste endliche vollständig positiv definite Nachgiebigkeit werden über orthonormale Richtungspaare ein endliches Minimum und Maximum angenommen; Grundlage sind Stetigkeit, Kompaktheit und ein strikt positiver Nenner.
de.catalog_directional_pair: Paarbeziehungen desselben Tensors: nu(n,m)/E(n)=nu(m,n)/E(m); abs(nu(n,m))<sqrt(E(n)/E(m)); 0<=nu(n,m)*nu(m,n)<1. Die oberen Ungleichungen sind strikt; das Produkt ist genau dann null, wenn beide Poissonzahlen null sind. Sonst haben die vertauschten Werte dasselbe Vorzeichen, müssen aber nicht gleich sein. Bei variablem E(n)/E(m) folgt keine endliche universelle numerische Grenze.

de.catalog_compressibility_notice: Nur Katalog: mathematische Beziehungen der hydrostatischen Antwort; keine Tensor-Eingabeauswertung, Inversion, Eigenwertberechnung oder Materialvorhersage.
de.catalog_compressibility_conditions: Geltungsbereich: endliche reelle, vollständig streng positiv definite dreidimensionale klassische isotherme infinitesimale Elastizität im spannungsfreien Referenzzustand. p>0 ist Druck: sigma=-p I, epsilon=-p(S:I). Zugspannung und Dehnung sind positiv. Hydrostatische Spannung kann Scherdehnung erzeugen und ist keine vorgegebene isotrope Dehnung. In technischer Voigt-Reihenfolge 11,22,33,23,13,12 gilt e=(epsilon11,epsilon22,epsilon33,2epsilon23,2epsilon13,2epsilon12); für g=S_eng*(1,1,1,0,0,0) gilt (B23,B13,B12)=(g4,g5,g6)/2.
de.catalog_compressibility_limits: Negatives beta bedeutet gerichtete Verlängerung unter hydrostatischem Druck; kappa>0 schließt negative Volumenkompressibilität aus. Höchstens zwei Hauptwerte können nichtpositiv sein, nicht höchstens zwei Richtungen negativ. Die Größe unterscheidet sich von einachsiger Poissonzahl und Wärmeausdehnung. Vorspannung, ebene Reduktionen, singuläre Tensoren, Phasenwechsel, eingeschränkte negative Volumenantworten und Massenaustausch sind ausgeschlossen. Eigene Projektbeweise und maschinell unterstützte Übersetzungen sind weder unabhängige wissenschaftliche Begutachtung noch muttersprachliche Prüfung; physikalische Realisierbarkeit ist nicht bestätigt.
de.catalog_compressibility_fixed_tensor: Für einen festen endlichen Tensor gilt beta(n)=n^T B n mit B=S:I. Der Wertebereich ist das abgeschlossene Intervall von lambda_min(B) bis lambda_max(B); beide endlichen Grenzen werden erreicht. Jede orthonormale Dreiergruppe summiert sich zu kappa=tr B>0, also beta_min<=kappa/3<=beta_max.
de.catalog_compressibility_range: Über die uneingeschränkte Klasse endlicher vollständig positiv definiter Tensoren nimmt r=beta/kappa jeden endlichen reellen Wert an, selbst bei festem positivem kappa. Dies folgt aus einer eigenen orthotropen SPD-Konstruktion des Projekts. Keine Unendlichkeit wird erreicht; ein einzelner fester Tensor hat keine unendliche Antwort.
de.catalog_compressibility_energy: Für denselben vollständigen Nachgiebigkeitstensor S gilt beta(n)^2<kappa/E(n), entsprechend r(n)^2<1/(kappa*E(n)). Diese strikte Bedingung ist notwendig, aber nicht hinreichend für vollständige positive Definitheit; Gleichheit ist ausgeschlossen. E(n)=1/(nn:S:nn)>0 ist der Young-Modul unter einachsiger Spannung.
de.catalog_compressibility_symmetry: Kubische und isotrope vollständig positiv definite Elastizität erfüllen dagegen r(n)=1/3 in jeder Richtung. Die Unbeschränktheit der Gesamtklasse gilt nicht für jede Symmetrieunterklasse. Isotrope hydrostatische Antwort allein beweist keine vollständige elastische Isotropie.
